Draft an ETL script for a study, experiment, or analysis

Source: R/draft_script.R
draftScript.Rd

Creates a template R script under the appropriate scripts/ subfolder. The DATA section is generated by codebookToDraft() from the variables defined in the named codebook.

Usage

draftScript(name, pillar, codebook_name, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

name

A character string specifying the name of the study, experiment, or analysis.

pillar

A character string; one of "studies", "experiments", or "analyses".

codebook_name

A character string specifying the codebook name.

overwrite

Logical. If TRUE, an existing script will be overwritten. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

Called for its side effects. Writes an R script and invisibly returns NULL.

See also

codebookToDraft(), codebookToSummary()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
draftScript("CoHSI1", "studies", "participant")
draftScript("NIH_CyTOF_exvivo", "analyses", "som_measurement")
} # }
